title: How Good Is NLP? A Sober Look at NLP Tasks through the Lens of Social Impact
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not conduct a benchmark measurement related to faith or religion. It proposes a theoretical framework to evaluate the social impact of NLP tasks in general.
findings: The paper does not analyze or make any findings related to religion. Its focus is on establishing a framework to evaluate the social impact of NLP research based on moral philosophy and global priorities, without specific analysis of religious contexts.
